e1_lr_baseline_comparison.title: LR baseline must compare AUPRC not only AUROC
e1_lr_baseline_comparison.reason: Original protocol references AUROC 0.837 as baseline. But selection criterion Priority 2 uses AUPRC. The LR baseline must be re-run on V2 inner splits to produce both AUROC and AUPRC for fair comparison.
e1_lr_baseline_comparison.rule: V2 candidate release AUPRC must exceed LR release AUPRC on identical inner-CV splits. V2 candidate release AUROC must also exceed LR release AUROC. Both conditions required.
lr_metrics_required: paired bootstrap 95% CI for AUROC and AUPRC delta
e1_lr_baseline_comparison.bootstrap_method: identity-paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, report 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles
e1_lr_baseline_comparison.inconclusive_rule: If V2 point estimate > LR point estimate but 95% CI crosses zero: status = HOLD_STATISTICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE. Do not claim victory.

e2_inner_cv_first_later_gap.title: Inner-CV uses fixed diagnostic threshold 0.5, not searched threshold
e2_inner_cv_first_later_gap.reason: CAL is not authorized. Inner-CV must not search thresholds.
e2_inner_cv_first_later_gap.rule: Compute first-event recall@0.5 and later-event recall@0.5. Report absolute gap. Also report threshold-free metrics: first-event AUPRC, later-event AUPRC, AUPRC gap.
e2_inner_cv_first_later_gap.note: 0.5 results are for DEVELOPMENT SELECTION ONLY. Final deployment threshold must be chosen by CAL on untouched data.

e3_nested_split_definition.title: Nested split is fold-relative
e3_nested_split_definition.rule: For outer fold f: outer_train = V1 fold f train identities; outer_val = V1 fold f validation identities. V2 inner-CV splits outer_train into 3 inner folds by identity. outer_val NEVER participates in training, inner validation, normalization, class weights, identity balancing, duration balancing, or model selection for fold f.
e3_nested_split_definition.cross_fold_note: The same identity may appear as outer_train in one fold and outer_val in another fold. This is acceptable and reflects the V1 fold design. Engineering OOF is therefore preliminary evidence, not final independent confirmation.

e4_past_only_temporal_jitter.title: Temporal jitter is strictly past-only
e4_past_only_temporal_jitter.rule: For target step t, jitter j in {0,1,2,3,4}. Input window covers [max(0, t-W-j+1), t-j]. The model must predict target step t using only information up to t-j. Missing recent steps are replaced by earlier history (extending the window leftward) or zero-padding. Under no circumstance may the input window end after step t.
forbidden: jitter that introduces information from t+1 or later

e5_event_auxiliary_loss_weight.title: Event auxiliary loss weight fixed at 0.3
e5_event_auxiliary_loss_weight.reason: Protocol specifies event auxiliary loss but not its weight relative to step BCE. Must be frozen before any training.
e5_event_auxiliary_loss_weight.rationale: Conservative weight — auxiliary loss should guide but not dominate. Step BCE remains the primary objective.
e5_event_auxiliary_loss_weight.no_tuning: This value is FROZEN. Must not be treated as a hyperparameter or adjusted based on inner-CV results.

e6_event_aggregation_for_evaluation.title: Event score aggregation matches V1 evaluator
e6_event_aggregation_for_evaluation.rule: Per-event score = max(probability) within known-mask region for that event. Same as V1 OOF evaluator. Event-positive = any step in event with target=True AND known_mask=True. Event-detected = event_score >= threshold.
e6_event_aggregation_for_evaluation.no_change: Must not change aggregation method between V1 and V2 evaluations.
